title: States Hold Forgotten Money For 1 In 7 Americans
hook: Your forgotten money may still exist: 1 in 7 has some waiting.
closing: Search your state database for free, because the missing money could be yours.
question: Have you checked your state database?

segments.say: California holds 15 billion dollars in unclaimed money. That cash still belongs to ordinary people.
States returned 4.49 billion dollars last year. Most unclaimed money still waits for its owners.
About 1 in 7 Americans has unclaimed money waiting. A free state search could pay off.
